prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Begin Your Desktop Companion Journey", "Choose whether to pick a classic pre-made pet or generate your own unique companion."]
1: ["Generating Your Unique Desktop Pet", "We are turning your photo into a animated desktop mascot."]
2: ["Meet Your Pet on Your Desktop!", "Complete these 3 quick actions to master your pet controls.", "1. Click pet to show control menu\n2. Drag pet around desktop\n3. Press shortcut to hide/unhide"]
3: []
4: ["Signing in with an existing account restores all your previous pets automatically."]
5: ["Select Your Adoption Method", "Pick an instant companion from our standard shelter or create a bespoke AI pet from your photos."]
6: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Home", "Initializing desktop overlay and sprite graphics engine. Your pet will spawn shortly!"]
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Official Adoption Verified"]
8: ["Starter Pack Unlocked: +3 Desktop Pet Treats"]
9: ["We'll notify you as soon as your pet is ready to hop onto your desktop."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or gifts (+3 Desktop Pet Treats).
